  Ten reporting checklists have been developed covering:

  General; Oral Medicine; Pathology and Radiology; Children with Special Healthcare Needs; Sedation and Hospital Dentistry; Behavior Guidance; Dental Caries; Preventive and Restorative Dentistry; Pulp Therapy; Trauma; Interceptive Orthodontics.
